units.source_text: ……本因坊夫人陪同老名人一直住在旅馆里。

en.t: ... Mrs. Honinbo stayed at the inn the whole time, attending the old Master.

units.source_text: 大竹夫人有三个孩子，大的才六岁，她得往返箱根和平塚之间。

en.t: Mrs. Otake had three children, the eldest only six, so she had to travel back and forth between Hakone and Hiratsuka.

units.source_text: 从旁看来，这两位夫人的苦心也是着实令人同情。

en.t: Seen from the outside, the anxieties and efforts of these two wives truly invited sympathy.

units.source_text: 八月十日，名人第二次带病续弈，两位夫人都是脸无血色，骤然消瘦，全都变了样。

en.t: On August 10, when the Master resumed play for the second time while ill, both wives were bloodless in the face, suddenly gaunt, and completely changed in appearance.
